card.name: Non- before skin and use terms
card.fires_on: The word "non" (or a nearby qualifier like severe, not) right before a condition or skin-state term, such as non-intact skin, nonsegmental vitiligo, non-continuous use, non-melanoma.

modes.label: Non- prefix
modes.description: The word non/Non starting a hyphenated or joined medical term about skin or use.

modes.label: Other qualifiers
modes.description: Short qualifying words like severe, with, not, or the before a patient condition or treatment site.
modes.example: Initiation of TRYVIO is not recommended in patients with<< severe>> anemia.
